what: Big slogan lines like ”Let’s work together.” stack in several rows, odd rows flowing left and even rows flowing right without breaks — speed × 250px per second (original .3 → 75px/s, 1.5× slower at 768 and below), and each row returns to its start after one item width, so there is no seam. It pauses when offscreen

options.[data-fx-part=row]: Flow row — appends two more copies of the items (children) inside
options.speed: Source unit (px per 4ms), default .3 → 75px per second

use:
Let’s work together.
Let’s work together.
note: The original shaved margin on every setInterval(0) (Chrome 4ms floor), so speed wobbled per tab and device — we divide by time and push at the same average speed.

from.where: index.html .ms-ticker (”Let’s work together.” two lines, speed .3) — original ticker component
